tasks.title: Blessing formula
tasks.detail: Learn Baruch, Atah, Eloheinu, Melech, Ha-olam.

tasks.title: Soulful Jewish Living
tasks.detail: Choose an episode on prayer, blessing, gratitude, Shabbat, or awareness.

tasks.title: Open My Heart
tasks.detail: Prayer-focused listening for the drive home.

tasks.title: Hamotzi vocabulary
tasks.detail: Lechem = bread • min = from • ha-aretz = the earth.

tasks.title: Use tonight’s table reading
tasks.detail: Notice Baruch, Eloheinu, Melech, Ha-olam, Lechem and Ha-aretz.

tasks.title: Table question
tasks.detail: Why might Judaism place the end and beginning of Torah beside each other?

tasks.title: Seven Minute Torah
tasks.detail: Listen for the Torah cycle’s ending/beginning and carry one question into Sunday.

tasks.title: Hadar: Mishnah/Talmud
tasks.detail: Listen to 2–3 short Mishnah lessons; focus on rabbinic reasoning.

tasks.title: Deuteronomy 34
tasks.detail: Read the end of Moses’ story. Ask what is left unfinished.

tasks.title: Genesis 1:1
tasks.detail: Move immediately from Torah’s ending to Bereshit.

tasks.title: Rashi on Genesis 1:1
tasks.detail: Ask: What problem does Rashi see, and why does he think Torah begins here?

tasks.title: Guiding question
tasks.detail: What does Rashi think Torah is actually trying to teach us?

tasks.title: First letters in familiar words
tasks.detail: Recognize Alef, Bet/Vet, Mem, Lamed and Hey inside words you already use.

tasks.title: Prayer-word recognition
tasks.detail: Work inside Baruch, Melech, Olam, Lechem and Ha-aretz.

tasks.title: Find the Shema
tasks.detail: Look at Hebrew → transliteration → direct translation in your siddur.

prayers.title: Blessing Formula
prayers.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם
prayers.translit: Baruch atah Adonai, Eloheinu melech ha-olam.
prayers.english: Blessed are You, Adonai our God, Sovereign of the universe.

prayers.title: Hamotzi
prayers.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם׃ הַמּוֹצִיא לֶחֶם מִן הָאָרֶץ
prayers.translit: Baruch atah Adonai, Eloheinu melech ha-olam; hamotzi lechem min ha-aretz.
prayers.english: Blessed are You, Adonai our God, Sovereign of the universe, who brings forth bread from the earth.
